        curr = monthly.loc[dept, months[i]]
        if prev > 0:
            growth = (curr - prev) / prev
            growth_rates.append(growth)
    avg_growth = np.mean(growth_rates) if growth_rates else 0
    mom_growth[dept] = {
        'may': monthly.loc[dept, '2025-05'],
